title: Zeta renormalization and pressure at infinity for an infinitely cusped tree lattice
summary: We study weighted periodic-orbit zeta functions for an infinitely cusped tree lattice $Y_q$, where $q\ge2$ is even and the quotient is a one-sided comb. The global Euler product fails coefficientwise because infinitely many primitive cycles have length four. A first-return determinant at a finite directed-edge set nevertheless exists, and stationary Schur elimination gives an algebraic formula for the root local zeta and its dominant poles.
